feat(pipeline): implement complete three-generation IoT anomaly detection pipeline (#61)

- Add Generation 1 basic pipeline with LSTM autoencoder and simple anomaly detection
- Add Generation 2 robust pipeline with enhanced error handling, validation, and resilience
- Add Generation 3 scalable pipeline with high-performance, auto-scaling, and streaming
- Include Docker multi-stage build and production deployment manifests
- Provide comprehensive test suites for all pipeline generations
- Add detailed documentation of architecture, deployment, and usage
- Implement production-grade deployment scripts and environment configurations
- Achieve quality gates for code correctness, security, performance, and production readiness

This commit delivers a full autonomous SDLC implementation for IoT anomaly detection, progressing from basic functionality to robust and scalable production-ready system.
